verdict.rationale: Discord documents a REST API ([discord-docs-35]), so offering a machine-readable spec is a fair question, but the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe got 404s on every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path ([discord-probe-3]). The llms.txt index and markdown docs ([discord-probe-1], [discord-probe-2]) are LLM-friendly documentation, not an API specification.
